signal_text: A blog post (dated July 20, 2025) states that Gumroad will not promote a product through the Discover page until the seller earns their first $10, with the author characterizing this as no free exposure from Gumroad before the threshold is met.
subject_exact: Gumroad Discover promotion eligibility threshold of $10 in earnings for product listing
